race.description: Nutrien Ag Solutions Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: OVERSHOOT (11) is the top pick after closing strongly into fifth at Coonabarabran, beaten two and a half lengths in a large maiden field when sent out at long odds. Her Queanbeyan fifth before that was also competitive, beaten a length and a half on soft ground, and she has a 1.5kg claim for a stable ranked strongly at this track. ARGYLE SPRINGS (9) is the main danger after going under by a head at Forbes as a well-supported favourite, with the lost gear passing the 150m adding merit to that near miss. ANDERS DIAMOND (7) still has to prove himself at around 1200m, but he strips fitter second-up, gets a 1.5kg claim and has Jacob Stiff, the top-ranked jockey for wins at this track, aboard. COMBY (10) has been safely held in two runs but caught the eye late on debut and is fitter third-up. Can improve enough to be a place-to-win fringe hope if the extra ground brings her on.
